description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutablePolicy class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package, verifying immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and behavior of policy modifications.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the ImmutablePolicy class, covering various aspects like immutability, JSON serialization, invalid inputs, and modification behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ImmutablePolicy class and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correct implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods for ImmutablePolicy.

methods.name: testInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a policy with an invalid (non-conforming or empty) PolicyId throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: testEmptyPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a policy with an empty PolicyId throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a Policy object to/from JSON creates an equivalent object.

methods.name: testToAndFromJsonWithSpecialFields
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization/deserialization with special or optional fields.

methods.name: removeEntryWorks
methods.description: Verifies that removing an entry from a policy produces a new policy without that entry.

methods.name: setSubjectsForWorks
methods.description: Tests setting new subjects for a given label, ensuring the policy correctly updates entries.

methods.name: setSubjectForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Verifies that setting a subject for a label copies existing data appropriately.

methods.name: setSubjectForShouldAddNewEntry
methods.description: Test that adding a subject for a new label creates a new entry with that label.

methods.name: removeSubjectForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Ensures removing a subject for a label produces a new policy without that subject.

methods.name: setResourcesForWorks
methods.description: Tests updating resources associated with a label in the policy.

methods.name: setResourceForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Verifies that setting a resource copies existing data correctly.

methods.name: removeResourceForShouldCopyExisting
methods.description: Ensures removing a resource for a label produces a new policy without that resource.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsForWorks
methods.description: Tests retrieving the permissions effecting a specific resource for a label and subject.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsForNonExistingShouldBeEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that requesting permissions for non-existing entries yields empty results.

methods.name: newPolicyIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures a new policy without entries is considered empty.

methods.name: newPolicyWithoutID
methods.description: Verifies that a policy created without an ID is considered empty.

methods.name: removeAllEntriesPolicyIsEmpty
methods.description: Confirms that removing all entries results in an empty policy.

methods.name: modifyingTheEntrySetDoesNotModifyThePolicy
methods.description: Checks that the set returned by getEntriesSet() is a copy and modifications do not affect the original policy.
